/bin/bash -c "mkdir -p tmp/pdfs
python3 - <<'PY'
from pypdf import PdfReader
from pathlib import Path
r = PdfReader('manuscript.pdf')
print('PAGES', len(r.pages))
print('METADATA', r.metadata)
pages = [p.extract_text(extraction_mode='layout') for p in r.pages]
for i, text in enumerate(pages):
 Path(f'tmp/pdfs/page-{i+1:02}.txt').write_text(text)
Path('tmp/pdfs/manuscript.txt').write_text('\\n\\n'.join(f'===== PAGE {i+1} =====\\n{t}' for i,t in enumerate(pages)))
print(pages[0])
PY"
